description: One environment (data source) at a time, and one or more of its VMs: the history of their full, incremental and binlog backups.

panels.description: Time since the start of the last full backup that reached the bucket, on the VM where it is oldest. Fulls run on Monday and Thursday, so up to 96 h is normal: amber from 108 h, red from 120 h.
panels.title: Oldest full backup

panels.description: Time since the start of the last incremental that reached the bucket, on the VM where it is oldest. There is no incremental on full backup days, so up to 48 h is normal: amber from 54 h, red from 72 h.
panels.title: Oldest incremental

panels.description: Time since the start of the last MySQL Shell backup that reached the bucket, on the VM where it is oldest. It runs daily, so up to 24 h is normal, plus the time the next backup takes until it has uploaded: red from 26 h.
panels.title: Oldest MySQL Shell

panels.description: Time since the last binlog upload that worked, on the VM where it is oldest: how much a lost server could lose. Amber from 30 min, red from 45 min.
panels.title: Oldest binlog backup

panels.description: VMs whose last full, incremental, MySQL Shell or binlog run, or its upload, failed.
panels.title: VMs with failures

panels.description: Closed binlogs not in the bucket yet, on the VM with the most. 0 after every healthy run.
panels.title: Most binlogs waiting

panels.description: The lowest free space on the /backup disk in the last 24 hours, on the VM with the least. The low point comes during the night's backup, before the old local backups are deleted. Red below 10 %, amber below 20 %.

targets.expr: min(100 * (min_over_time(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"}[24h]) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"}) * on (instance) group_left (exported_instance) group by (instance, exported_instance) ({__name__=~"node_mysql_(backup|incremental_backup|shell_backup|binlog_backup)_status", exported_instance=~"$vm"}))

panels.title: Lowest /backup free, 24 h

panels.description: One row per VM: the result and age of its last full, incremental and binlog backups. A last run is Failed when the backup or its upload failed. Empty cells: that backup type does not run on the VM. MySQL Shell backups are in their own table. Click a VM for its details.

targets.expr: max by (exported_instance) (100 * (min_over_time(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"}[24h]) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"}) * on (instance) group_left (exported_instance) group by (instance, exported_instance) ({__name__=~"node_mysql_(backup|incremental_backup|shell_backup|binlog_backup)_status", exported_instance=~"$vm"}))

panels.title: Every VM

panels.description: The VMs with MySQL Shell backups: the result and age of the last one, and their /backup free space. Last result is Failed when the dump or its upload failed. It runs daily, so up to 24 h is normal, plus the time the next backup takes until it has uploaded: red from 26 h. Click a VM for its details.

targets.expr: max by (exported_instance) (100 * (min_over_time(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"}[24h]) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"}) * on (instance) group_left (exported_instance) group by (instance, exported_instance) ({__name__=~"node_mysql_(backup|incremental_backup|shell_backup|binlog_backup)_status", exported_instance=~"$vm"})) and on (exported_instance) node_mysql_shell_backup_status{exported_instance=~"$vm"}

panels.title: MySQL Shell

panels.description: Time since the start of the last full backup that reached the bucket. It climbs until the next full finishes its upload: a sawtooth up to 96 h is healthy. Dashed: amber 108 h, red 120 h.
panels.title: Full backup age

panels.description: Each VM's last backup step and its upload. The upload row is empty while an upload runs: the script adds that result only when the upload ends.
panels.title: Full backup result

panels.description: How long each successful XtraBackup full backup took, the backup step and its upload together: one dot per run, joined per VM. Hover a dot for that run. Log scale, so short and long runs are both readable.
panels.title: Full backup run time

panels.description: The size of each successful XtraBackup full backup: one dot per run, joined per VM. Hover a dot for that run. Log scale, so large and small VMs are both readable.
panels.title: Full backup size

panels.description: Free space on each VM's /backup disk. Dashed: amber below 20 %, red below 10 %.

targets.expr: 100 * (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/backup"}) * on (instance) group_left (exported_instance) group by (instance, exported_instance) ({__name__=~"node_mysql_(backup|incremental_backup|shell_backup|binlog_backup)_status", exported_instance=~"$vm"})

panels.title: /backup free space

panels.description: Time since the start of the last incremental that reached the bucket. Up to 48 h is normal, since there is no incremental on full backup days. Dashed: amber 54 h, red 72 h.
panels.title: Incremental age

panels.description: Each VM's last incremental and its upload. "No base" (no full backup in the chain) shows as Failed.
panels.title: Incremental result

panels.description: How long each successful incremental backup took, the backup step and its upload together: one dot per run, joined per VM. Hover a dot for that run. Log scale, so short and long runs are both readable.
panels.title: Incremental run time

panels.description: The size of each successful incremental backup: one dot per run, joined per VM. Hover a dot for that run. Log scale, so large and small VMs are both readable.
panels.title: Incremental size

panels.description: Time since the start of the last MySQL Shell backup that reached the bucket. It runs daily: a sawtooth up to 24 h, plus the time the next backup takes until it has uploaded, is healthy. Dashed: red at 26 h.
panels.title: MySQL Shell age

panels.description: Each VM's last MySQL Shell backup (dump and encrypted archive) and its upload.
panels.title: MySQL Shell result

panels.description: How long each successful MySQL Shell backup took, the backup step and its upload together: one dot per run, joined per VM. Hover a dot for that run. Log scale, so short and long runs are both readable.
panels.title: MySQL Shell run time

panels.description: The size of each successful MySQL Shell backup: one dot per run, joined per VM. Hover a dot for that run. Log scale, so large and small VMs are both readable.
panels.title: MySQL Shell size

panels.description: Time since the last binlog upload that worked. A sawtooth up to the cron interval is healthy; a ramp is an outage. Dashed: amber 30 min, red 45 min.
panels.title: Binlog backup age

panels.description: Each VM's last binlog run.
panels.title: Binlog backup result

panels.description: Closed binlogs not in the bucket yet. 0 after every healthy run. Dashed: amber from 1, red from 3.
panels.title: Binlogs waiting

panels.description: Binlogs that reached the bucket in each hour: the write load in binlogs. 0 means nothing was uploaded.
panels.title: Binlogs uploaded per hour

panels.description: How long a run took. Past a few minutes, runs start to overlap the cron interval.
panels.title: Binlog run time, successful runs

title: MySQL backups detail
